title: Clean the washable air filters (Aerovane)
steps: [{"n": 1, "say": "Switch the AC off with the remote and then at the wall switch.", "check": "The display is dark."}, {"n": 2, "say": "Lift the front panel gently until it stays open (the manual's 'open the front grille' step).", "check": "The panel holds by itself."}, {"n": 3, "say": "Slide each mesh filter straight out.", "check": "Both filters are in your hands."}, {"n": 4, "say": "Rinse them under a tap with plain water, no hot water, and shake off the water.", "check": "Water runs clear."}, {"n": 5, "say": "Dry them in shade for 10 minutes, slide them back and close the panel.", "check": "The panel clicks shut."}, {"n": 6, "say": "Switch on and set cooling mode; wait 15 minutes.", "check": "Airflow is stronger."}]
worst_case: Filters are put back wet; the household is told to dry them first.

title: Clean the washable air filters (Zenith)
steps: [{"n": 1, "say": "Switch the AC off with the remote and then at the wall switch.", "check": "The display is dark."}, {"n": 2, "say": "Open the front panel from the two side notches as the manual shows.", "check": "The panel holds by itself."}, {"n": 3, "say": "Lift each filter out of its slot.", "check": "Both filters are out."}, {"n": 4, "say": "Rinse them under a tap with plain water and shake off the water.", "check": "Water runs clear."}, {"n": 5, "say": "Dry them in shade for 10 minutes, refit and close the panel.", "check": "The panel clicks shut."}, {"n": 6, "say": "Switch on, set cooling mode and wait 15 minutes.", "check": "Airflow is stronger."}]
worst_case: Filters are put back wet; the household is told to dry them first.

title: Look at the drain hose from the floor
symptom_terms: {"water dripping indoors","wall wet","water from front panel"}
steps: [{"n": 1, "say": "Switch the AC off at the wall switch and put a towel or bucket under the leak.", "check": "The unit is off."}, {"n": 2, "say": "Standing on the floor, follow the thin drain hose from the unit to where it leaves the wall.", "check": "You can see the hose."}, {"n": 3, "say": "Check that the hose has no kink and that its end is lower than the unit.", "check": "No kink, end is lower."}, {"n": 4, "say": "Run the AC for 30 minutes and watch the leak point.", "check": "Dripping stops."}]
worst_case: Nothing changes; the household is told to leave the AC off.

steps: [{"n": 1, "say": "Switch the AC off with the remote.", "check": "The display is dark."}, {"n": 2, "say": "Switch off its MCB or wall switch and wait two minutes.", "check": "Two minutes have passed."}, {"n": 3, "say": "Switch the MCB back on and start the AC.", "check": "The unit starts normally."}]

title: Clean the drain pump filter (Wavecrest)
steps: [{"n": 1, "say": "Switch the machine off and pull the plug out of the socket.", "check": "The plug is out."}, {"n": 2, "say": "Place a flat tray and towels in front of the machine and open the small filter cover at the bottom right.", "check": "The cover is open."}, {"n": 3, "say": "Turn the filter a quarter turn left slowly and let the water drain into the tray.", "check": "Water stops flowing."}, {"n": 4, "say": "Take out lint, coins and clips, and rinse the filter.", "check": "The filter is clean."}, {"n": 5, "say": "Refit the filter fully, close the cover and wipe the floor.", "check": "The cover is closed."}, {"n": 6, "say": "Plug in and run a drain or spin cycle.", "check": "The drum empties."}]
worst_case: A little water on the floor; the household is told to stop if the filter will not turn.

steps: [{"n": 1, "say": "Switch the machine off and pull the plug out of the socket.", "check": "The plug is out."}, {"n": 2, "say": "Open the lower service flap and place a tray under it.", "check": "The flap is open."}, {"n": 3, "say": "Turn the filter left slowly and let the water drain.", "check": "Water stops flowing."}, {"n": 4, "say": "Remove lint and coins; rinse the filter.", "check": "The filter is clean."}, {"n": 5, "say": "Refit the filter and close the flap.", "check": "The flap is closed."}, {"n": 6, "say": "Plug in and run a drain cycle.", "check": "The drum empties."}]

title: Clear the lid and press it shut
steps: [{"n": 1, "say": "Switch the machine off at the wall and remove anything caught under the lid edge.", "check": "The lid edge is clear."}, {"n": 2, "say": "Close the lid and press down firmly at the centre until you hear a click.", "check": "You heard a click."}, {"n": 3, "say": "Switch on and press start.", "check": "The cycle starts."}]

title: Check the outlet hose for a kink
symptom_terms: {"will not drain","water drains slowly","repeat drain complaint"}
steps: [{"n": 1, "say": "Switch the machine off and pull the plug out.", "check": "The plug is out."}, {"n": 2, "say": "Look along the outlet hose from the side without moving the machine.", "check": "You can see the hose."}, {"n": 3, "say": "If it is bent sharply, straighten it by hand.", "check": "The hose runs in a smooth curve."}, {"n": 4, "say": "Make sure the hose end is not pushed deep into the standpipe.", "check": "The end sits loose above the water line."}, {"n": 5, "say": "Plug in and run a drain cycle.", "check": "The drum empties."}]

steps: [{"n": 1, "say": "Close the door on a sheet of paper and pull it out; check the paper grips all the way round.", "check": "The paper grips."}, {"n": 2, "say": "Look inside for items blocking the air vents at the back.", "check": "Vents are clear."}, {"n": 3, "say": "Check that the thermostat dial is at the mid setting.", "check": "Dial is at the mid setting."}, {"n": 4, "say": "Leave the door shut for two hours and check the temperature again.", "check": "It recovers."}]
